product_one_liner.value: Aikido is a developer-first security platform that helps development and security teams secure their code, cloud, and runtime environments without slowing software delivery.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing includes a free Developer plan.

employee_band.notes: Company size listed on its LinkedIn profile.

eng_blog.notes: Engineer-authored posts explain Altar model compression and Opengrep implementation, including contributions by lead engineer Selim Decamps and OCaml engineer Dimitris Mostrous.

public_docs.notes: The public help center contains multiple articles covering account setup, findings management, code scanning, and cloud scanning.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: An AI Engineer opening in Tel Aviv describes building vulnerability-investigation and code-fixing agents.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims include SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022. GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a formal certification.
